title: Regulatory Citation Record
description: A single requirement extracted directly from a source PDF in /standards. Every field is mandatory; no value may be supplied from memory, assumptions, industry defaults, or a derived YAML database.

source_pdf_filename.description: Exact PDF filename under /standards the requirement was read from.

page_number.description: Page number within the source PDF. If unavailable, use the exact string 'Source document required for verification'.

quoted_requirement.description: Verbatim quote of the requirement text from the PDF. No paraphrasing.

extracted_structured_value.description: The structured value parsed from the quote (number, ratio, boolean, or object). Must be traceable to the quote.

structured_field_name.description: Optional canonical field name this requirement maps to.

verified.description: True only if source_pdf_filename exists in /standards AND page_number is an integer AND quoted_requirement is non-empty.
